What each state means and what evidence it needs is in [README.md](README.md). A state other than Unqualified is accepted only when cited evidence under `tests/fixtures/qualification/` shows it; `qualify.py matrix --check` enforces that in CI. No row says PASS: a state names the evidence behind it.

## Evidence

- `lab-sw-access-17` (synthetic): Synthetic 48-port access switch with ENTITY-MIB placement; no LAG. Classification: Interfaces ok, ENTITY ok, MAU ok, LLDP ok, VLAN ok, STP ok, LAG empty.
- `lab-sw-core-01` (synthetic): Synthetic 24-port switch: LACP uplink, RSTP, VLAN access and trunk ports, a 100M half-duplex port. Classification: Interfaces ok, ENTITY ok, MAU ok, LLDP ok, VLAN ok, STP ok, LAG ok.
- `lab-sw-dist-01` (synthetic): Synthetic distribution switch without port entities or LAG; holds the blocking alternate port of the triangle. Classification: Interfaces ok, ENTITY absent, MAU ok, LLDP ok, VLAN ok, STP ok, LAG empty.
- `lab-sw-dist-02` (synthetic): Synthetic distribution switch and RSTP root, with LACP and static LAGs. Classification: Interfaces ok, ENTITY absent, MAU ok, LLDP ok, VLAN ok, STP ok, LAG ok.
- `lab-sw-stack-01` (synthetic): Synthetic two-member stack with ENTITY-MIB member/slot placement and a static LAG across members. Classification: Interfaces ok, ENTITY ok, MAU ok, LLDP ok, VLAN ok, STP ok, LAG ok.
